Botsyouname,scheduleandmention.

A bot is a name, a job, standing rules and one thread that keeps context, running on Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi or plain Chat. Message it, put it on a routine, or mention it from any other thread and the work moves to it.

A name, a job, a thread that keeps context

Create one in about ten seconds. Pick its engine: Chat for answers from your context, or OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex or Pi for a computer of its own. Its standing rules ride along on every turn.

Routines run it on a schedule

Weekdays at 9:00, every hour, or a cron line. Each firing lands in the bot's own thread with the history intact, so Monday's digest knows what Friday's said.

Mention it and the work moves

Type @bot/Reviewer in any thread. That part of the job goes to Reviewer in its own thread, and you get a receipt: handed off, continued, or refused with the reason. Bots never answer in each other's name.
